title: IdentitySteal Resourcepack
description: The official textures for IdentitySteal — adds custom designs for all  role cards and special items
body:
# 🎨 IdentitySteal Resource Pack > *The official resource pack for the IdentitySteal plugin.* --- ## ✨ Overview This resource pack is **REQUIRED** for the full experience of the **[IdentitySteal](https://modrinth.com/project/identitysteal)** plugin. It adds custom textures for all identity cards, items, and UI elements. Without this pack, identity cards and special items will appear as plain paper! --- ## 📦 What's Inside? This pack features high-quality custom textures for: ### 🃏 Identity Cards Unique card designs for all 9 roles, making it easy to identify your current power at a glance: - 👁️ **Observer Card** - ⚔️ **Imposter Card** - 👻 **Ghost Card** - ⚓ **Anchor Card** - 🔥 **Rebel Card** - 📖 **Prophet Card** - 🎭 **Pawn Card** - 🪞 **Mirror Card** - 📚 **Archivist Card** ### 🛠️ Special Items - 🎲 **Identity Roller** — A custom texture for the randomization item. - 🔄 **Identity Swapper** — A unique design for the identity exchange item. --- ## 📥 Installation 1. **Download** the latest version of the resource pack. 2. Place it in your `%appdata%/.minecraft/resourcepacks` folder. 3. Launch Minecraft and go to **Options > Resource Packs**. 4. Move **IdentitySteal Pack** to the right side (Selected). 5. Click **Done**! > **Server Owners:** You can host this pack and set it as the server resource pack in your `server.properties` so players download it automatically! --- ## 🔗 Links - 🧩 **[Get the Plugin](https://modrinth.com/project/identitysteal)** ---
### Made for IdentitySteal by younggamingdj
